name: multi-hop-reasoning
description: Facts require linking multiple memories to answer. Tests consolidation + multi-hop retrieval.

facts: Sally is an accountant at EY
Sally passed the CPA exam soon after she joined EY
Sally joined EY in 2006
Sam has been friends with Sally since college
cases.question: When Sam first knew Sally, did Sally have her CPA?
reasoning_chain: CPA came after joining EY in 2006
cases.expected_answer: No — Sam knew Sally in college, which was before she joined EY in 2006, and she only passed the CPA after joining EY.

facts: Maria lives in Jersey City
Maria's office is in Manhattan's Financial District
The PATH train runs from Jersey City to the Financial District in about 25 minutes
Maria dislikes driving into Manhattan because of parking costs
cases.question: How does Maria most likely get to work, and why?
cases.expected_answer: The PATH train — it connects Jersey City to the Financial District directly (~25 min), and she avoids driving due to parking costs.

facts: Ken is submitting a paper to NeurIPS

Ken starts experiments two months before any deadline

cases.question: When did Ken most likely start his experiments?
cases.expected_answer: Around mid-March 2026 (two months before the May 15 deadline).

facts: Priya's daughter has a piano recital on June 3 at 6pm
Priya has a work offsite on June 3
The offsite ends at 4pm in Stamford
Stamford to Priya's home is about an hour by train
cases.question: Can Priya make it to the recital on time?
cases.expected_answer: Yes, but tight: offsite ends 4pm, ~1 hour home puts her there around 5pm, one hour before the 6pm recital.
